simple.meaning: מֵאֵן (mêʼên) is a Hebrew action word meaning “refractory.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 13:10. The surrounding contexts include birth.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֵאֵן (H3987) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מֵאֵן (mêʼên) / H3987 is traced through Jeremiah 13:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.
